title: Streak and achievements
summary: A logging streak with freeze tokens, and badges for what was logged.

requirements.text: A day counts toward the streak when it has a meal, a hand-logged workout, a capture, a legacy supplement dose, or a fast running; synced workouts, readings, observations and sleep do not count.

history.text: The streak counts consecutive days with anything logged; a day inside a multi-day fast counts.
history.reason: Version 1 said anything logged counts; only these kinds do.

requirements.text: Every `streak.freeze-every` straight days earn a freeze token, up to `streak.max-freezes` banked.
A banked freeze covers a missed day automatically, only to bridge back to an earlier logged day, and is refunded if that day is logged later.

history.text: A banked freeze covers a missed day automatically.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't say when a freeze is spent or that it is refunded.

requirements.text: The streak is shown in the Diary header and opens the achievements.
Achievements are derived from the database, so past history counts, except event-only ones, which are recorded when they happen.

history.text: Achievements are derived from the database, so past history counts and a missed scan loses nothing.
history.reason: Version 1 said every achievement is derived; a few (such as one capture logging several entries) can only be seen as they happen.

requirements.text: Each tier family of a counting badge shows as a single row climbing to its next tier.
